page.layout: One column of running text. Below the text, at the foot, the signature "M 4" at the left and the catchword at the right. A narrow strip at the right edge carries a stray "202" beside the first line, which I have not transcribed (see notes). Left-edge marks are show-through or the neighbouring page.

main_text.p: est. Ad hanc communionem ante oftendimus; primùm formam internam, quàcum Deo coa-lescimus, pertinere: deinde externam, qua col-ligimur ad verbum ipsius percipiendum, preces exhibendas, praestandum obsequium, & ordi-nem honestatemq; in his omnibus rebus pro-curandam. Noftrum est, ut in his ipsis rebus summa religione ac studio aliis omnibus prae-eamus sermone, & factis. Quid hic excusatio-nis vel in speciem adferre possunt, qui aut ser-mone aut factis non ita procurant aedificatio-nem illius corporis, quod Deus suo sanguine comparauit? Equidem perhorresco totus, nec sine dolore acerbissimo recolere possum cum animo meo, quantam Ecclesiae labem, quan-tam sibi ipsis ruinam accersiuerint, qui sive prudentes, sive imprudentes ab hoc officio suo defciuerunt. Faxit Dominus; ne quis porro de-scifcat, & se machinationibus Satanae ab hoc sanctissimo instituto vocationis suae abripi pa-tiatur. Grauissima fane vulnera non nobis so-lum infligimus; sed ipsi Ecclesiae Christi, quam curae nostrae Dominus commendauit; cum dic-tis aut factis ab illo sine quem Deus imperat, aberramus, obliuiscentes illius pacis quam in Ecclesia Dei nos constantissimè oportet expe-tere. Nam cur non expendamus, quandoqui-dem administri sumus Christi & dispensatores mysteriorum Dei; cur (inquam) non expenda-mus diligentissimè dicta factaque nostra, quae
[The last word of the page is cut off by the lower edge of the scan; left as printed.]

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "ab alife" in the catchword, read as "ab aliis" with [?]. The "202" at the top right edge is not clearly part of this page's text and has been left out. Long s is read as s throughout; words such as "factis" and "fane" are read with a real f, where the scan does not show a crossbar. "vel in speciem" is read as printed ("velin"), with a probable word division. Possible printing error: "vel in" for "vel in" as printed. The first word is "est" with a long s, printed as "est" in the transcription.
